caseName: Federal Maritime Commission v. South Carolina State Ports Authority
caseNameFull: Federal Maritime Commission v. South Carolina State Ports Authority

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 971.] Motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument granted, and the time for oral argument is divided as follows: 20 minutes for the Federal Maritime Commission and 10 minutes for the Solicitor General.
